class.name: RFDetrPipeline
class.brief_description: Loaded rf-detr checkpoint, kept resident across [method detect] calls.
class.description: Holds the [code skip-lint]rfdetr_model[/code] handle so a batch of frames shares one loaded weight set instead of paying [code skip-lint]rfdetr_model_load[/code] per invocation. Same shape as [Pixal3DPipeline], [SkinTokensPipeline], [KimodoPipeline].

method.name: load
method.description: Load the rf-detr checkpoint. Required key [code skip-lint]checkpoint_path[/code]. Optional keys: [code skip-lint]num_queries[/code], [code skip-lint]score_threshold[/code].

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method load] has succeeded and [method unload] has not been called since.

method.name: unload
method.description: Release the loaded checkpoint. Safe to call more than once. The destructor also calls this.

method.name: detect
method.description: Detect boxes in [param image_rgba]. Same return shape as [method RFDetrModel.detect] but reuses the loaded weights across calls.
